category_definitions.unique approved: Nonancestor tip exactly matches a merged PR head; accepted by merge, with content equivalence and formal approving-review status not established.
category_definitions.unapproved experimental: Nonancestor or unknown tip without verified exact-tip acceptance; classification means approval and activity are unverified, not that experimental intent is proved.
category_definitions.duplicate: Exact tip equals another current branch tip. Nonancestor duplicates remain on hold.
category_definitions.active: Known interrupted WIP or an open PR; retain.
category_definitions.no longer needed: Conditional category for the historical recovery branch: archive eligible only after a durable bundle covering its exact head is verified.
